scope: Definition correction before any OP scoring or efficacy experiment; original brief retained
findings: The current main library states that since August 2016, BE for fiscal years ending in 1993 or later no longer adds deferred taxes and investment tax credit.
The August 2018 notice includes minority interest in the operating-profitability denominator. The separate size-OP detail page omits this update.

The September 2020 notice describes profitability as operating income before depreciation and amortization less interest, scaled by book equity; the explicit August 2018 minority-interest update must also be considered.

The size-OP detail page permits missing individual expenses when revenue, positive book equity and at least one expense field exist in the source database. This is not evidence that a missing SEC XBRL tag represents zero.
impact: The prior brief's simple R-COGS-SGA-interest / BE wording is incomplete as a strict replication of the current French reference. A direct annual XBRL accounting adaptation must have its own explicit meaning and label; no fallback to net income/assets or silent substitution of OperatingIncomeLoss.
status: Scientific accounting-target review pending; no factor scores or market outcomes computed
historical_results: Published French portfolio returns remain unchanged; this correction concerns the definition and qualification of new stock-level inputs.
